summary_md: **VinciEye ([@vincieye](https://x.com/vincieye/status/2116164650614112289))** presents *SonoWorld4D* ([arXiv 2610.40640](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40640v1), [project](https://humathe.github.io/sonoworld4d/)), which turns one monocular video into an audio-visual 4D scene with a 360° background, motion trajectories and a physically grounded sound field.
